description_en: Updates the face synchronization relationship between a user group and a device group
description_zh: 调用该接口，更新用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual update-face-user-group-and-device-group-relation --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --control-id qcb2yea4ha4d0000 --relation SYNC_INFO_PICTURE --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation

parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID that isolates data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the IsolationId that you specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group. Set this parameter to the ControlId value that you obtained and saved locally when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID。请传入调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时，获取并保存到本地的**ControlId**值
parameters.name: control_id

parameters.help_en: The face synchronization relationship. Currently, only SYNC_INFO_PICTURE is supported, which indicates that user photos and user information are synchronized
parameters.help_zh: 人脸同步关系。当前仅支持设置为SYNC_INFO_PICTURE，表示同步用户照片和用户信息
parameters.name: relation

Code.description_en:
The response code.
200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

ControlId.description_en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
ControlId.description_zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group was last updated
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后一次更新用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时间

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
